{1}The team{/1}
Who we are

Tom is a FinOps Certified Practitioner with a scientific background in artificial intelligence. Within FinOps he focuses on AI infrastructure: he knows what high-density compute environments demand and how to set them up well, both technically and financially.

Jelle has a background in finance and focuses on FinOps and cost management for cloud and AI. He speaks the language of both the CFO and the engineer, and makes sure tech spend becomes a conscious choice instead of a surprise on the invoice.
{1}Why FinOps?{/1}
Technology growth without cost control is a risk.
Cloud and AI spend often grows faster than revenue. AX1S brings finance and engineering together to turn that into structural savings.
FinOps is the practice in which finance and engineering take joint ownership of cloud and AI costs, instead of finance checking costs after the fact.
Every team sees its own usage and keeps steering on it, instead of cost control being an annual exercise.

The FinOps Foundation is the non-profit organisation behind this practice, part of the Linux Foundation. It develops the FinOps framework, the annual State of FinOps benchmark and the FinOps Certified Practitioner certification, which our team has also earned.

Questions about FinOps and AX1S Infra

FinOps stands for Financial Operations: finance, engineering and operations work together to keep cloud and AI spend under continuous control instead of checking it after the fact. {1}Read the full explanation of FinOps{/1}.
Who is AX1S Infra suited for?
AX1S Infra helps digital-first companies that want to save structurally on cloud and AI costs, from the right purchasing choices to optimising existing environments.
How much can I save with FinOps?
Customers save an average of 23% on their cloud and compute spend after a FinOps engagement. Take the free {1}FinOps Radar{/1} for an estimate tailored to your situation.
How quickly will I see results?

That differs per organisation and engagement, but in practice we often see quick wins within the first weeks, followed by structural optimisation. One customer, for example, achieved {1}23% savings within a focused engagement{/1}.
What does an intake with AX1S Infra cost?
Nothing. The intake is free and non-binding: together with you we map the savings potential, without obligations, with a reply within 24 hours.
Do you also offer no cure no pay?

Yes, that's possible. For a number of services we can work on the basis of a percentage of the savings achieved, instead of a fixed fee. We're happy to discuss together what suits your situation best.
What services does AX1S Infra offer besides FinOps?
Besides FinOps and cost management we offer managed colocation (Tier III/IV facilities in Europe) and hardware brokering for AI workloads and enterprise-grade uptime.
Are AX1S Infra's consultants certified?
Yes. Both founders, Jelle van Zantwijk and Tom Prager, are FinOps Certified Practitioners, certified by the FinOps Foundation.
